site.name: Charlotte
site.description: Open-source MCP server that renders web pages into structured, agent-readable representations using headless Chromium. Runs locally over stdio or self-hosted as a remote HTTP server (Docker) that clients like claude.ai can connect to over a tunnel. 43 tools for AI agents to navigate, observe, and interact with the web.
